description: Retrieve your memories from SAIHM and decrypt them in this process; the server never sees plaintext. Use this at the start of a session, or whenever past context is needed. Pass query to filter by keyword, or leave it out to load everything. Pass cellId alone to read one of your own cells. To read a single cell another agent shared with you, pass their sharerPinnedAgentIdHashHex and sharerRecord together with the cellId; that path is read-only. Pass listOnly to list your cells' versions without their content. Pass sharesOnly to list every pointer shared with you, a page at a time, where the endpoint offers it. With warmStart "latest", it instead restores the newest encrypted warm-start snapshot into the payload file named by token; "list" lists them.

after.description: With listOnly or sharesOnly: the next value of the previous page.

cellId.description: The cell id to read: alone, one of your own cells; with the sharer fields, the shared cell (required then).

listOnly.description: List your own cells' versions (cellId, seq, commitment) without reading any content. Pages: pass the answer's next as after until next is null.

query.description: Filter your OWN memories by keyword (empty = all). Ignored when reading one cell by cellId.

shareEntries.description: With the share events feed on, also return every entry of the share map; without it, only its summary.

sharerPinnedAgentIdHashHex.description: Read a cell shared TO you: the SHARER's agentIdHash (hex), pinned out-of-band. When set, sharerRecord and cellId are also required.

sharerRecord.description: The SHARER's published identity record (hex fields). Required with sharerPinnedAgentIdHashHex.

sharesOnly.description: List every pointer shared with you, a page at a time and never cut, without reading any memory. Pages: pass the answer's next as after until next is null. Answers shares_paging_unsupported where the endpoint does not offer it: then recall without it.

token.description: With warmStart: 16 to 32 characters from a-z and 0-9, chosen at random for this call. It names the payload file. Blank otherwise.

warmStart.description: "latest" restores the newest snapshot into warm-start/latest-<token>.bin (read it, then remove it); "list" lists snapshots. Only token goes with it. Leave it blank to recall memories.

name: saihm_recall
title: Recall
